title: SDR daily scratchpad - Maya Singh - 2026-03-06
content:
Daily goals:
- 25 dials (focus EMEA mornings)
- 15 meaningful conversations (get calendar invites)
- 5 solid MQL -> AE handoffs

Quick priorities (top 3):
1) Follow up with FinTech pilot prospects from last week (Airtel Capital, StoneLake) - move to demo stage
2) Rebook demo for HubOps (demo no-show yesterday) - find decision maker, push for Thurs 3/12
3) Clean up 'stalled' list: update statuses, remove duplicates, add 2 new contacts per account

Today schedule (blocks):
- 08:30 - 09:30: Prospecting (EMEA). Focus: renewables + fintech lists.
- 09:30 - 10:45: Inbound queue + email follow-ups.
- 11:00 - 12:00: Call blitz (Airtel Capital, StoneLake, HubOps)
- 12:00 - 13:00: Lunch / admin notes
- 13:00 - 15:00: Meetings / demos (if booked) + LinkedIn outreach
- 15:00 - 16:00: Follow-up sprint (leave voicemails, send calendars)
- 16:30 - 17:30: Update CRM + AE sync notes

Call list (priority order):
1) Airtel Capital - Tim Reynolds (tim.reynolds@airtelcap.com) - spoke 3/2, interested in latency/cost numbers. Need sample throughput numbers + pricing band. Action: email pricing + ask for 30m demo.
   notes: mentioned compliance concerns, ask about on-prem requirement. Likely Dedicated.
2) StoneLake Analytics - Priya Kumar (priya.k@stonelake.ai) - demo scheduled 3/9 but needs data retention info. Action: send compliance one-pager + confirm demo time.
3) HubOps - Michael Chan (michael@hubops.io) - missed demo yesterday, DM'd on Slack. Action: rebook, ask for technical stakeholders.
4) BlueCart Logistics - Sarah Gold (sarah.gold@bluecart.com) - interested in embeddings for search. Action: send embedding latency & cost example + invite to office hours.
5) NovaRetail - Carlos Mendes (carlos@novaretail.com) - Champion unclear, assigned to AE if convo goes > discovery. Action: leave voicemail, follow-up email.

Follow-ups (timing + script notes):
- Airtel: Email template "Airtel follow-up - throughput + demo" (link in Confluence) + attach 1-pager. Ask: preferred hours for demo? Who needs to attend?
- StoneLake: Confirm data retention requirement (30/60/90 days) and whether SOC2 report required.
- HubOps: "Hey Michael, saw you couldn't make it. Can we try Thurs 3/12 at 3pm?" Template: short, include quick bullets on value (latency, cost savings with batching).

Pipeline quick notes:
- Airtel Capital: MEDIUM. pain: cost predictability. Close timeline: Q2 pilot. Next: pricing + demo.
- StoneLake Analytics: HIGH. pain: compliance + retention. Next: compliance doc + confirm demo.
- HubOps: LOW -> MEDIUM (depends on stakeholders). Next: rebook demo, identify PoC.
- BlueCart Logistics: MEDIUM. interest in embeddings. Next: send embed examples + schedule office hours.

Objections to prep for (short bullets):
- "We can self-host cheaper" -> compare TCO + ops cost + time to ship features
- "Latency is too high for our use case" -> share latency SLOs, discuss Dedicated + routing
- "Data residency" -> mention Private deploy / VPC options, KMS/HSM support

Templates to use today:
- cold-call script: quick intro, 30s value prop, ask for 15m exploratory call
- follow-up email: 3 bullets (why now, quick ROI, ask for meeting)
- pricing note: put ranges, emphasize pilot discounts

Notes to self / TODO (scratchy):
- update Airtel contact in CRM -> Tim Reynolds labeled incorrectly as "Tim R" (fix email)
- remove duplicate BlueCart contact (from last quarter)
- upload new compliance one-pager to drive and link in Confluence page
- ping AE Sam for HubOps handoff if demo rebooked

Random thoughts / brainstorms:
- Could build a short calculator for customers to estimate token cost vs. Dedicated commit to show break-even in 6 months (ask PM/eng for simple inputs)
- Run an "embedding office hours" webinar for retail/commerce verticals next month (collab with marketing)

End-of-day metrics I'll update in CRM:
- calls attempted: __
- conversations (>= meaningful): __
- demos booked: __
- MQLs -> AE handoffs: __

Anything urgent: ping Jordan (DM) or drop note in #sdr-urgent

- Product ask: need updated latency numbers for quantized models (PR to eng Observability) -> JIRA-SD-782
